# Built In

> > Built In is a technology publication covering AI, blockchain, cloud computing, IoT, robotics, and the intersection of emerging technologies with business, recruitment, and society.

Built In provides news, analysis, and practical guides on cutting-edge technologies including artificial intelligence, machine learning, blockchain, and IoT applications. The site also features comprehensive resources for tech recruitment, HR technology, and employer branding, serving both technology professionals and business leaders navigating digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Blockchain & Cryptocurrency
- Internet of Things (IoT)
- Cloud Computing
- Robotics & Automation
- Recruitment & HR Technology
- Applicant Tracking Systems
- Employer Branding
- Supply Chain & Logistics
- Computer Vision
- Deep Learning
- Fintech & Payment Processing
- ChatGPT
- Google DeepMind
- Universal Robots

## Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

- [20 Deep Learning Applications You Should Know](https://builtin.com/artificial-intelligence/deep-learning-applications): 20 deep learning use cases from computer vision to NLP applications
- [21 Examples of AI in Supply Chain and Logistics](https://builtin.com/artificial-intelligence/ai-in-supply-chain): 21 companies using AI for supply chain optimization including Coupa, Samsara
- [DeepMind AI folds protein, wins contest](https://builtin.com/artificial-intelligence/deepmind-ai-folds-protein-wins-contest): Google's DeepMind AlphaFold wins protein-folding contest in Cancun
- [Scientists bolster giraffe conservation efforts with AI](https://builtin.com/artificial-intelligence/scientists-bolster-giraffe-conservation-efforts-ai): Wildbook AI platform aids Giraffe Conservation Foundation tracking efforts
- [Hackers can generate AI fingerprints to hack phones, study shows](https://builtin.com/artificial-intelligence/hackers-can-generate-ai-fingerprints-hack-phones-study-shows): NYU/MSU study shows DeepMasterPrints GANs can fool fingerprint scanners

## Recruitment & HR Technology

- [64 Recruitment Tools To Know in 2025](https://builtin.com/recruiting/recruitment-tools): Comprehensive guide to 64 recruitment tools including LinkedIn and Greenhouse
- [8 Recruitment Metrics That Matter Most to Track](https://builtin.com/recruiting/recruitment-metrics): Guide to 8 key recruitment KPIs using Workday, Lever, and Greenhouse
- [Employer Branding: Lessons From 7 Failed Rebrands](https://builtin.com/articles/what-7-failed-rebrands-can-teach-us-about-employer-branding): Employer branding lessons from failed rebrands like Tropicana and BP

## Cloud Computing & Enterprise Technology

- [50 Cloud Companies You Should Know in 2026](https://builtin.com/articles/cloud-computing-companies): Directory of 50 cloud providers including Salesforce, Oracle, and Dropbox
- [26 Top Payment Processing Companies 2026](https://builtin.com/articles/fintech-payments-companies-examples): Guide to 26 fintech payment processors and ACH processing solutions
- [Amazon woos agencies with new data-driven advertising platform](https://builtin.com/articles/amazon-woos-agencies-new-data-driven-advertising-platform): Amazon's data-driven ad platform tested by Omnicom and WPP agencies

## Blockchain & Cryptocurrency

- [Yale University among investors in new $400 million crypto fund](https://builtin.com/blockchain/yale-university-among-investors-new-400-million-crypto-fund): Yale invests in Paradigm's $400M crypto fund led by Coinbase's Ehrsam
- [Blockchain is helping refugees make financial inroads](https://builtin.com/blockchain/blockchain-helping-refugees-make-financial-inroads): Gravity Earth uses blockchain for refugee financial inclusion in Nairobi
- [Blockchain, machine learning to assist Thailand's Revenue Department in tax probes](https://builtin.com/blockchain/blockchain-machine-learning-assist-thailands-revenue-department-tax-probes): Thailand deploys blockchain and ML for tax evasion detection system

## Internet of Things & Connected Devices

- [IoT in Education: 10 Key Examples](https://builtin.com/articles/iot-education-examples): 10 IoT applications transforming classrooms with smart learning devices
- [California seeks to regulate Internet of Things devices](https://builtin.com/articles/california-seeks-regulate-internet-things-devices): California law mandates reasonable security features for IoT devices
- [Voice recognition devices struggle to understand stutterers](https://builtin.com/articles/voice-recognition-devices-struggle-understand-stutterers): Voice assistants like Siri fail accessibility for stutterers per U Toronto

## Robotics & Automation

- [Robot bartender to debut at Mile High during Broncos-Browns game](https://builtin.com/robotics/robot-bartender-debut-mile-high-during-broncos-browns-game): Universal Robots' UR5e debuts as NFL's first robot bartender at Mile High
- [Verily, Alphabet life sciences arm, to develop sensor-enhanced shoes](https://builtin.com/articles/verily-alphabet-life-sciences-arm-develop-sensor-enhanced-shoes): Verily develops sensor-enhanced shoes for movement and fall detection
